review_text: I had a great time at Marseli - Cafe & Patisserie. The drinks, especially the two we have tried, were good.  The atmosphere was good, and the service was quite attentive. It's a lovely spot to relax and enjoy. 😊 I'd recommend it for a pleasant outing! ✨
Overall it was a good experience
Fantastic experience at Marseli. I had grilled chicken and  pasta and blueberry cheesecake. All are perfect taste. Ising service was great. A must visit.
